purpose: A recipe is typed executable law that decomposes exact inputs into typed trees or recomposes transformed trees into exact realizations through a validated substrate ISA program; it is not importer configuration or an opaque callback.

grammar_boundary.providers: Tree-sitter generated parsers scanners grammar metadata media codecs standards parsers and Laplace-native grammars are replaceable syntax providers behind one typed grammar registry
grammar_boundary.provider_output: exact concrete syntax nodes fields byte spans errors missing nodes and source positions
grammar_boundary.laplace_lowering: a versioned recipe lowers provider output into the universal typed AST and witnesses every grammar symbol field alias omission recovery and ambiguity
grammar_boundary.laplace_recomposition: a versioned recipe selects and orders witnessed grammar constructions to realize a typed AST or semantic act as exact content without using token continuation as the semantic engine
grammar_boundary.round_trip: an exact decomposition recipe and its declared inverse recompose byte-identical content; an intentional transformation recipe emits new content plus an exact tree edit and relation receipt
grammar_boundary.structural_transformation: translation paraphrase correction register tone reference polarity degree and modality changes operate on typed AST roles and semantic acts rather than unreceipted string replacement
grammar_boundary.custom_grammars: Laplace-native grammar providers are first-class authorities wherever the product declares its own exact syntax; the complete inventory and conformance behavior must be independently specified and cannot be inferred from historical implementation artifacts

a grammar provider cannot own composition persistence evidence cognition or realization semantics

a programming-language grammar cannot make code architecturally privileged
a realization template cannot bypass semantic-act completion or AST transformation receipts

execution.primary_shape: vector set run and whole-working-set batches
execution.scalar_law: one item lowers through the same canonical implementation
execution.fanout_law: one calculated canonical stream may feed multiple typed sinks without semantic recalculation
execution.provider_law: providers may vary parsing transport storage acceleration numeric kernel or effect mechanism only where the contract permits and cannot change semantic output order evidence completion or receipt meaning
execution.resource_law: all nested providers partition one conserved topology-aware resource grant
execution.determinism_law: partition batch size scheduling route and replay do not change logical results
execution.persistence_law: canonical calculated state witnessed state derived epochs acceleration planes and effects retain separate publication authority

application_and_federation.universal_primitives: people organizations accounts projects activities entitlements achievements pages nodes and provider assertions lower to the same typed AST referential occurrence testimony governance recipe effect and receipt forms according to role
application_and_federation.projection_law: a profile feed resume portfolio or personal web is a query-relative audience-authorized materialization recipe over pinned referential and evidence epochs rather than a mutable canonical account blob
application_and_federation.entitlement_law: authenticated external assertions remain time-scoped testimony while governance recipes calculate current capability display and effect authority without changing identity or history
application_and_federation.surface_law: web mobile API document and future product surfaces realize the same selected semantic structure and may not implement private query identity evidence entitlement or visibility semantics
application_and_federation.federation_law: an authenticated content-addressed exchange binds world scope audience authority recipe epochs exact structures withheld dispositions and receipts; replay converges without reminting content
application_and_federation.provider_law: identity billing discovery relay backup hosting storage and synchronization providers remain witnessed or physical providers and cannot become semantic authority
application_and_federation.node_law: CPU operating system form factor resource and placement differences select accepted physical plans only; unsupported targets remain typed unsupported rather than receiving a reduced engine

evolution.rule: a semantic recipe change creates a new append-only coordinate fingerprint and receipt; it never rewrites prior content testimony calculation or epoch history
evolution.calculus_extension: a discovered recipe or grammar extension remains a falsifiable candidate until disjoint evidence counterexamples authority and activation gates accept a new version
evolution.unknown: unsupported grammar recipe field or operation is an explicit typed outcome rather than guessed lowering
